title: Vote Censorship Anza Technical Report 2026
text:
Vote Censorship Attack on Solana - Anza Technical Report 2026

Attack description:
- Malicious leader excludes vote transactions from specific validators
- Targeted validators accumulate delinquent votes
- Stake-weighted voting disrupted for censored validators
- Can be used to selectively exclude validators from consensus

Technical mechanism:
- Leader controls transaction inclusion during their 4-slot window
- Vote transactions have no special protection from censorship
- Censored validator loses vote credits, affecting stake rewards
- Sustained censorship can cause validator delinquency

Detection indicators:
- Specific validator vote success rate drops while others stable
- Vote transactions confirmed for all validators except target
- Pattern of missed votes correlating with specific leaders
- Validator delinquency without local performance issues

Mitigations:
- Vote transaction encryption proposals (SIMD-pending)
- Multiple vote submission paths
- Validator reputation scoring
- Leader accountability mechanisms
- Slashing for provable censorship
Source: Anza Technical Report 2026
